answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one canyon weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. The opal report shows the merge explicitly at each delta. Because of that, someone who spins up 89 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 269 times the capital for one share. A farm of 3536 identities would post 1820 proofs and burn roughly 84 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
